description: Wave 6D-13 strictly read-only console probes (45 probes across 4 batches) covering UI tile tree & HUD queries (Get/SetUIFloat/Alt, ModUIFloat, Get/SetUIString/Alt/Ex, GetUIFloatInherited locus chains, Inject/UnloadUIComponent, InjectUIXML, IsComponentLoaded, SUP GetUIValueType/GetUIElementType/SetUIFloatMultiple/DumpTileInfoToArray, SetUIFloatGradual + SUP gradual queries, GetStringUIDimensions, SUP HudBar lifecycle & HudBarGetPos, Get/SetHUDVisibilityOverride vs Get/SetHUDVisibilityFlags & Get/SetHUDShudderPower stub, MenuMode/GetActiveMenuMode/IsMenuPaused/GetButtonPressed/GetPipBoyMode/TogglePipBoyLight, corner message queue & ClearMessageQueue, ToggleHUDCursor/Get/SetCursorPos/ToggleMouseMovement, active UI/screen/font/loadscreen queries); controls, keys & input (Disable/EnablePlayerControls short-arg matrix, Disable/EnablePlayerControlsAlt/AltEx & disabledHow 0/1/2, GetControl/GetAltControl, Disable/EnableControl vs Disable/EnableKey cross-interaction & GetDisabledKeys, SetControl/SetAltControl, HoldKey/ReleaseKey + GetPressedKeys/GetNumKeysPressed/GetKeyPress IgnoreKeyStatus=0/2, GetKeyName table, IsControl/SetIsControl, hotkeys & Get/SetHotkeyItemRef, gamepad buttons/triggers/sticks/deadzones, IsControlPressed & HoldControl/ReleaseControl); camera, POV, FOV, crosshair & movement (SetCameraFOV / GetCameraFOV / GetPlayerCamFOV / GetPackedPlayerFOV stub, ToggleFirstPerson / IsPC1stPerson / GetCameraTranslation 1st vs 3rd local frame, ToggleFlyCam/GetTFC/CAMS, GetCrosshairRef/Ex/Water/CrosshairRefInList/ObjectUnderReticle, GetReticlePos/Alt/Range/Node/TargetLimb, sneak/run/AlwaysRun/ForceSneak/ForceRun/WalkSpeed/RunSpeed, movement flags/air/swim/AutoMove/FallTime, furniture/sitting/sleeping/knocked/ragdoll/aiming/IsPlayerActionActive, GetActorVelocity/Alt & GetLinearVelocity, SetWeaponOut/HolsterWeapon timing, WorldToScreen ref offset & JGLegacyWorldToScreen stub); and animations, idles, weapon-anim, kNVSE, NIF blocks & paths (IsAnimPlaying/Ex/ExCond/PlayGroup/GetSequenceAnimGroup, PlayIdle/Ex/ForcePlayIdle/ForceStopIdle/StopIdle/GetPlayedIdle, Get/SetIdleLoopTimes & Get/SetIdleAnimPath, all FOSE/Anh weapon-anim getters & setters, kNVSE pre-first-tick GetAnimationAttributes offset/lastTime & SetActorAnimationPath + unlisted kNVSE stubs, Get/SetNifBlockFlag/Scale/Translation/Rotation + pcModel 1/2, ModelHasBlock/InsertNode/Rename/Remove, GetObjectDimensions & JG 3D node distances / SUP verticles, all 18 model/icon/texture/biped/scope/skeleton path getters & setters, and equipment biped mask, slot visibility, FaceGen/hair/eyes flags, and SetRefrModelPath).
